description: Use when someone asks whether their game is on Foundplay, how it is doing there, or how many plays it has. Looks the game up by play link, Foundplay page link or slug. Returns whether it is listed; if so, its page, status, whether Foundplay's link check finds its play link working, public plays, upvotes and comments, whether its maker has claimed it, and whether a boost can be bought for it; if not, the free listing link. Read-only; it does not load the game. Next steps: get_listing_link to list it, get_boost_options if the person asks about paid promotion.

game.description: The game's play link (where people play it), its Foundplay page link, or its Foundplay slug.

name: check_game

outputSchema.description: Whether the game is listed on Foundplay and, if so, its public numbers.

canBoost.description: Whether no listing-level block to buying a boost was found. Not approval: every boost is reviewed after payment.

canonicalUrl.description: The game's Foundplay page without tracking, to cite.

claim.description: The link where the maker claims the listing, or null when it is claimed.

claimed.description: Whether its maker has claimed the listing, which lets them edit it.

dropAt.description: The accepted drop time, as an ISO timestamp; only present while waiting for that drop.

linkWorks.description: false while Foundplay's link check finds the play link down.

listForFree.description: For a game that isn't listed: the link that opens the submit form, filled in when a play link was given.

listed.description: Whether the game is on Foundplay now.

listedOn.description: The day it was listed, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC).

next.description: The next step, stated as a fact about where things stand.

page.description: The game's Foundplay page, to open.

plays.description: Public play count on Foundplay. See playsMeaning.

status.description: The public listing state: live, waiting for its drop, hidden while its link is down, waiting for review, or taken down.
enum: hidden while its play link is down

takenDown.description: true when the game was listed and has been taken down.

whyNotBoostable.description: Why a boost can't be bought for it, or null.

title: Check a game on Foundplay
